conflicts_noticed: ETH Zurich tuition (ethz-msc-cs): https://ethz.ch/en/studies/financial.html says 'ETH tuition and semester fees sum up to CHF 804/semester.' (no fee groups mentioned), while https://ethz.ch/students/en/studies/financial/tuition-fees.html says 'Threefold tuition fee: CHF 2190 / semester' for everyone who does not qualify for the simple fee (CHF 730), which includes typical Pakistani applicants. Both are proposed. The 804 figure appears to be the simple-fee total and is likely outdated or misleading for international applicants.

TUM tuition (tum-msc-informatics), a pending change rather than a second value: the program page states 6,000 euros per semester, but https://www.tum.de/en/studies/fees/tuition says Master's fees for non-EU students rise for the winter semester 2027/28 to 4,600 or 6,800 euros per semester. Neither band equals 6,000, and the fee page does not say which band Informatics falls in. Only 6,000 is proposed; WS 2027/28 starters will probably pay a different amount.
